changelog:
- Detailed error reporting for take_screenshot when accessibility service is disabled.
- Fixed silent uninstall failure on Android 12+ (added FLAG_MUTABLE intent) and hidden API crash.
- Fixed take_screenshot failure reporting on non-rooted Android 10 and below.
- Expanded dashboard layout for wide screens.
- Fixed gallery issue preventing photos from appearing.
- Optimized audio bandwidth (dropped silence frames) while maintaining 16kHz quality.
- Enhanced camera night mode with max exposure compensation for brighter photos.
